thread:
michael: Heads up — vendor (SkyForward) updated lead times. Partial wave: 30 units arriving week of 23 May, remaining 60 in early June. PO RF-4123. Need ops plan for EU staging + RMA path. AWB pending. cc @jenni @raj
jenni: Noted. Do we have manifest details? If serials are partial we can't accept depot staging until reconciliation. Can vendor pre-advise serial CSV?
skyforward: We can provide pre-advise CSV EOD tomorrow. Draft AWB: EB1234567890 (subject to final). Insurance via our forwarder; will confirm declared value. Proposing split shipment: 30 air, 60 sea-air. Any EU customs HS concerns?
raj: EU HS good. Need clarity on import VAT flow for temporary loaners. Also FRA depot has limited slots week of 23 — callout for timed delivery.
linda: Ops note — FRA depot only ~16 dock slots/day. For 30 units we need timed delivery window + photo evidence on unload. RMA flow: prefer consolidated AWB + single RA reference per PO to avoid multiple tickets.
michael: Can vendor mark items as 'non-saleable' for return path? Also what's your RMA SLA if some arrive DOA? We need TAT <= 7 days for swaps on critical units.
skyforward: Default RMA SLA is 10 business days. 7-day SLA possible for dedicated fleets at +12% unit surcharge. We can label items for return but not 'non-saleable' by default. Offer depot pre-inspection at origin for +$75/unit.
jenni: Can we accept 10 days if we route through dedicated lane? Clarify pricing for +12% — is that on net unit price? Need sample packaging photos.
skyforward: Surcharge = 12% of unit line price, applied per invoice line for opted units. Pre-inspect cost $75/unit (one-time). We'll upload packaging photos and sample serial CSV to the shared drive.
raj: Proposed ops decision: accept 30 units to EU pool under standard SLA; opt into 7-day SLA for 10 critical units (pay surcharge). Vendor must pre-advise serial CSV and provide consolidated AWB for the 30. Ops to book timed dock.
linda: Carrier preference: ForwardEx (supports timed slot API). If vendor cannot use ForwardEx, we will switch to our procured forwarder and deduct incremental cost from vendor credit.
michael: Action items: @skyforward send CSV by EOD tomorrow; provide final AWB numbers; confirm surcharge opt-in for 10 critical units; provide adjusted invoice lines. @linda reserve FRA dock provisional slot Wed 24 May AM. @jenni prep RA template.
linda: Reserved provisional slot Wed 24 May 09:00-11:00 (provisional). Will update when vendor confirms timed ETAs.
jenni: RA template ready — RA-RF-4123-###. Includes fields: PO, AWB, serials link, depot, accept window, photos required. Snippet:
```
RA ID: RA-RF-4123-001
PO: RF-4123
AWB: 
Serials CSV link: 
Depot: FRA-DEPOT-3
Notes: pre-inspect required for sampled units
```
ops-bot: Reminder: create shipping hold tag `staging:pending-serials` on arrival until serial reconciliation complete.
michael: :thumbsup: If vendor misses CSV deadline we'll delay staging and push full wave into mid-June. Keep updates coming.
skyforward: Affirmative — will send CSV EOD (ETA 17:45 CET) and confirm which 10 units opt into 7-day SLA. Will also upload packaging photos and final AWB tomorrow morning.
